githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 Beta 2 adds upload metadata removal, filename anonymisation, a Photos picker, and compression for oversized attachments. It also introduces a Features settings page and fixes DM ordering, animated reactions, and server nickname editing.

## Upload privacy

- Added removal of location, camera, and other personal metadata from supported images and videos before Discord or external uploads. This is enabled by default and preserves media quality without modifying the original files.
- Added a confirmation when metadata cannot be removed, allowing the file to be attached unchanged or cancelled.
- Added optional filename anonymisation, preserving file extensions and spoiler markers, with per-attachment controls to restore the original name.

## Photos and attachments

- Added “Select from Photos” to the message composer for attaching images and videos from the Photos library.
- Added local compression for oversized images and videos, with Higher quality, Balanced, and Smaller files options.
- Added separate Automatically, Ask, and Never settings for compression and external uploads. Both default to Ask, and automatic external uploads can use Catbox or Litterbox.
- Improved the composer’s attachment menu to show actions available in the current conversation.

## Features settings

- Added a dedicated Features page for hidden-channel visibility, FakeNitro, and attachment handling.
- Added individual toggles for FakeNitro emojis, stickers, soundboard, and stream quality.
- Added support for the new preferences in settings search, deep links, and import and export.

## Messaging and interface fixes

- Fixed message searches unexpectedly reordering existing DMs or replacing their current channel information.
- Fixed animated reactions overlapping their static images and placeholders.
- Fixed server nickname editing to respect the current user’s server permissions.
- Fixed the server rail scrollbar appearing when macOS is configured to always show scrollbars.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6-Beta-1...v0.1.6-Beta-2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6-Beta-1...v0.1.6-Beta-2)
discordAnnouncement:
**Upload privacy, Photos picker, and attachment compression 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Image and video uploads now remove personal metadata by default, with a prompt if removal fails.
- Optional filename anonymisation hides original names, with per-attachment controls.
- Select images and videos directly from your Photos library.
- Compress oversized media with adjustable quality, and choose when to use Catbox or Litterbox.
- A new Features page brings together hidden-channel visibility, individual FakeNitro toggles, and attachment settings.
- Fixed DM ordering after searches, overlapping animated reactions, and server nickname editing permissions.
